title: BEP interview state is complete enough for governed assembly
test_intent: Determine whether a captured BEP interview state can be assembled without inventing required project facts, silently dropping unresolved dependencies, or omitting an applicable interview domain.

applicability.applies_when: A BEP interview is claimed complete or a project BEP draft/review package is about to be assembled from captured project state.
applicability.not_applicable_when: The interaction is exploratory and no complete BEP interview state or assembly claim is being made.

required_evidence: known project facts with source/evidence traceability
conflict and deviation records where applicable

result_logic.pass: Every datum required for the requested BEP state is supported, explicitly unresolved, formally deferred, identified as a conflict, or recorded as a deviation candidate; all applicable interview modules are represented and no project fact has been invented to close a gap.
result_logic.fail: The interview is declared complete while an applicable required domain was skipped, a required project datum was silently defaulted or invented, or unresolved/deferred/conflict/deviation state was discarded during assembly.
result_logic.not_applicable: No complete interview-state or BEP assembly claim is being tested.
result_logic.indeterminate: The requested BEP state, project evidence, module coverage or unresolved/deferred register is insufficient to determine completeness.

provenance.derived_from: BEP Interview Production — Punch List (Readiness to Production), Confluence page 14090241; current workflow TIVERIT-BIM-WF-BEP-INTERVIEW-ASSEMBLY-001
provenance.migration_note: Promotes the durable end-to-end readiness condition into abstract conformance. It does not claim that a runtime ETS or generator implementation already exists.
